title: Daily average temperature and daily HDD/CDD
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily Tmax, Tmin [n_days] (F or C), base B (65 F / 18 C). DITANYAKAN: Daily average and daily HDD, CDD (degree days). RUMUS: Card 1-2: T_d = (Tmax + Tmin)/2; HDD_d = max(B - T_d, 0); CDD_d = max(T_d - B, 0). JAWAB: 1) sort dates, check unique. 2) T_d. 3) HDD_d, CDD_d. 4) check HDD_d CDD_d = 0 each day, both >= 0.
pitfalls: rounding T_d before computing degree days only if the contract says so

title: Monthly HDD index per historical year
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily Tmax, Tmin [n_days] over many years, base, contract month. DITANYAKAN: HDD index per year for that month [Y] (degree days). RUMUS: Card 2 + V1: index = SUM over all calendar days of the month of HDD_d. JAWAB: 1) daily HDD. 2) filter month. 3) group by year, sum. 4) keep years with complete month. 5) check index values are ~days x average HDD (hundreds in winter), not a daily mean.
formulas: I_y = sum_{d in month, year y} HDD_d
pitfalls: average daily HDD reported as monthly index

title: Seasonal CDD index (multi-month strip) per year
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily temps, base, season window (start month-day, end month-day inclusive). DITANYAKAN: Seasonal CDD index per year. RUMUS: Card 2: sum of daily CDD over every day in the window, both ends inclusive. JAWAB: 1) daily CDD. 2) window mask per year. 3) sum. 4) check equals sum of monthly CDD over the strip months.

title: HDD call option by burn analysis
frame: DIKETAHUI: historical daily temps [n_days], base, period, strike K (index points), tick (currency/point), r, T (years to payment). DITANYAKAN: Payoff per year, mean payoff, discounted burn price (currency). RUMUS: Card 3-4: payoff_y = tick max(I_y - K, 0); price = e^{-rT} mean_y payoff_y. JAWAB: 1) index per year [Y]. 2) payoffs. 3) mean. 4) discount. 5) check price >= 0, tick applied.

title: HDD put option by burn analysis
frame: DIKETAHUI: historical temps, base, period, K, tick, r, T. DITANYAKAN: Burn price of the put. RUMUS: Card 3-4: payoff_y = tick max(K - I_y, 0). JAWAB: 1) indices. 2) put payoffs. 3) mean, discount. 4) check put decreases when K lower.

title: Capped CDD call by burn analysis
frame: DIKETAHUI: historical temps, base, period, K, tick, cap (currency), r, T. DITANYAKAN: Capped payoff per year and burn price. RUMUS: Card 3: payoff = min(tick max(I - K, 0), cap). JAWAB: 1) indices. 2) uncapped payoff. 3) cap. 4) mean, discount. 5) check capped <= uncapped.
pitfalls: cap given in index points vs currency: convert with tick

title: Weather collar and straddle by burn analysis
deliverables: table: year, index, leg payoffs, net payoff
frame: DIKETAHUI: historical index per year [Y] (or temps), strikes K_call, K_put, tick, r, T, positions. DITANYAKAN: Net payoff per year and price of the combination. RUMUS: Card 3 legs: call tick (I-Kc)^+, put tick (Kp-I)^+; collar = long call - short put (or reverse); straddle = call + put at K. JAWAB: 1) leg payoffs. 2) net with signs. 3) mean, discount. 4) check price = sum of leg burn prices.

title: Burn analysis with linear detrending of the index
frame: DIKETAHUI: index per year [Y], target year y*, K, tick, r, T. DITANYAKAN: Trend slope, detrended indices, burn price on detrended history. RUMUS: Card 4 / V5(b): OLS I_y = a + c y; detrended I'_y = I_y + c (y* - y); payoffs on I'. JAWAB: 1) OLS. 2) shift each year to target level. 3) payoffs. 4) mean, discount. 5) check mean(I') = a + c y*.

title: HDD futures fair value and futures P&L
frame: DIKETAHUI: index history per year (or model), tick, entry futures level F0, final index I, n contracts. DITANYAKAN: Fair futures level (index points) = E[I]; contract value tick F; P&L tick (I - F0) n. RUMUS: Futures price under burn = mean_y I_y (no discount for futures margining). JAWAB: 1) E[I]. 2) value in currency. 3) P&L per position sign. 4) check long gains when index above entry.

title: HDD swap with fixed strike, cap and floor
frame: DIKETAHUI: index per year, K, tick, cap/floor on payment, r, T. DITANYAKAN: Swap payoff per year, clipped, and value. RUMUS: Swap payoff = tick (I - K) clipped to [-floor, cap]; value e^{-rT} mean payoff; fair K = E[I] when unclipped. JAWAB: 1) payoff. 2) clip. 3) mean, discount. 4) fair strike. 5) check sign convention (receiver of HDD).

title: Descriptive statistics of historical degree-day indices
deliverables: summary json: mean, sd, min, max, p10, p50, p90
frame: DIKETAHUI: index per year [Y]. DITANYAKAN: Mean, sd (ddof=1), quantiles of the index. RUMUS: Sample moments; numpy quantile (state method). JAWAB: 1) indices. 2) stats. 3) check all >= 0, winter HDD > summer HDD.

title: Celsius degree days with base 18 C
frame: DIKETAHUI: temperatures in C, base 18 C (or converts from F), K in C-degree-days, tick. DITANYAKAN: Index in C degree days and option price. RUMUS: Card 2 with B = 18; never mix units: F to C via (F - 32) 5/9 before averaging; degree days scale 5/9 only if bases align. JAWAB: 1) unit check. 2) daily avg, HDD/CDD in C. 3) index, payoff. 4) check magnitudes ~ 5/9 of F equivalents.
pitfalls: 65 F base used on Celsius data

title: Missing temperature data handling before indexing
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily temps with gaps/duplicates; contract period. DITANYAKAN: Cleaned series, indices per complete year. RUMUS: Card completing inputs: forward-fill single gaps unless told to drop; drop duplicate dates; years kept only if the full window exists. JAWAB: 1) sort, dedupe. 2) reindex daily calendar. 3) fill per rule. 4) index per year. 5) report counts.

title: Leap-year treatment in February and seasonal windows
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily temps covering leap years, period including February. DITANYAKAN: Index per year with correct day count. RUMUS: CME: period index sums all calendar days in the period (Feb 29 included in leap years). JAWAB: 1) day mask by calendar. 2) count days per year. 3) index. 4) check n_days 28/29 consistency.
formulas: I = sum over all calendar days in period

title: Seasonal mean temperature fit with trend and sinusoid
deliverables: summary json: a, b, amplitude, phase
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily average temps [n_days], t = day index (0..), period 365 (or 365.25). DITANYAKAN: Coefficients of s(t) = a + b t + c sin(2pi t/365 + phi); residuals. RUMUS: Card 5: OLS T = a + b t + c1 sin(w t) + c2 cos(w t); c = sqrt(c1^2 + c2^2), phi = atan2(c2, c1), w = 2pi/365. JAWAB: 1) t index. 2) design matrix. 3) OLS. 4) amplitude/phase. 5) residuals = T - s(t). 6) check residual mean ~ 0.
formulas: s(t) = a + b t + c sin(2 pi t/365 + phi)
c = sqrt(c1^2 + c2^2), phi = atan2(c2, c1)

title: Temperature OU parameters from deseasonalised residuals
deliverables: summary json: phi, kappa_per_day, sigma_per_sqrt_day, half_life_days
frame: DIKETAHUI: residuals e [n_days] from seasonal fit. DITANYAKAN: kappa per day, sigma per sqrt(day), half-life (days). RUMUS: Card 5 / V4(a): AR(1) e_t = phi e_{t-1} + eps (no constant; toolkit ar1_fit(e, add_const=False)); kappa = -ln phi; sigma = sd(eps) sqrt(2kappa/(1-phi^2)); ou_from_ar1(0, phi, sigma_e, dt=1). JAWAB: 1) AR(1) through origin. 2) map. 3) half-life ln2/kappa days. 4) check 0 < phi < 1.

title: Annualised temperature OU parameters
deliverables: summary json: kappa_daily, kappa_annual, sigma_daily, sigma_annual
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily kappa and sigma (from AR(1)). DITANYAKAN: Annualised values as asked. RUMUS: Card V4(b): kappa_annual = 365 kappa_day; sigma_annual = sqrt(365) sigma_day. JAWAB: 1) daily fit. 2) scale. 3) report the unit the task names. 4) check half-life unchanged in days.

title: Month-varying volatility in temperature model
frame: DIKETAHUI: residuals e [n_days] with dates, phi (or kappa). DITANYAKAN: sigma per calendar month. RUMUS: Alaton et al.: sigma_m from eps within month m (or quadratic-variation estimator sqrt(1/N_m sum (dT)^2)); sigma_m = sd(eps_m) sqrt(2kappa/(1-phi^2)) under exact mapping. JAWAB: 1) innovations eps. 2) group by month. 3) sd per month. 4) map. 5) check winter sigma > summer for continental cities.

title: Monte Carlo HDD option price with temperature OU
frame: DIKETAHUI: seasonal mean s(t), kappa, sigma (per day), start temp T0, contract days [n_d], K, tick, r, T, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC price, SE (currency), mean simulated index. RUMUS: Card 5-6: residual Y exact OU per day; T_d = s(d) + Y_d; index = sum HDD_d per path; price = e^{-rT} mean(tick (I-K)^+); SE = DF sd/sqrt(N). JAWAB: 1) Y0 = T0 - s(t0). 2) simulate [n_paths x n_d]. 3) HDD per day, index [n_paths]. 4) payoff, discount, SE. 5) check vs burn within ~20%.
formulas: Y_{d+1} = Y_d e^{-kappa} + sigma sqrt((1-e^{-2kappa})/(2kappa)) Z
pitfalls: simulating from the long-run mean instead of the observed start temperature

title: Monte Carlo CDD call price
frame: DIKETAHUI: seasonal fit, OU params, summer window, K, tick, r, T, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: MC CDD call price and SE. RUMUS: Card 5-6 with CDD_d = max(T_d - B, 0). JAWAB: 1) simulate window. 2) CDD index per path. 3) payoff with tick, cap if any. 4) discount, SE. 5) check mean index near historical mean.

title: Expected HDD index analytically under Gaussian temperature
frame: DIKETAHUI: seasonal mean and OU params, start Y0, contract days, base B. DITANYAKAN: E[I] = sum_d E[max(B - T_d, 0)]. RUMUS: T_d ~ N(m_d, v_d) with m_d = s(d) + Y0 e^{-kappa (d-t0)}, v_d = sigma^2(1-e^{-2kappa(d-t0)})/(2kappa); E[(B-T)^+] = (B-m) N(z) + sd phi(z), z = (B-m)/sd. JAWAB: 1) m_d, v_d. 2) daily expected HDD. 3) sum. 4) compare to MC mean index.
formulas: E[(B - T)^+] = (B - m) N(z) + s phi(z), z = (B - m)/s

title: Normal approximation of index distribution for option price
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily T distributions (m_d, v_d) and OU autocovariance; K, tick, r, T. DITANYAKAN: Approx price with I ~ N(mu_I, s_I^2). RUMUS: Alaton: when T_d < B almost surely in winter, HDD_d ~ B - T_d; mu_I = sum (B - m_d); s_I^2 = sum_i sum_j Cov(T_i, T_j), Cov = v_i e^{-kappa (j-i)} (j>=i); call = DF tick [(mu_I - K) N(z) + s_I phi(z)], z = (mu_I - K)/s_I. JAWAB: 1) mu_I. 2) covariance sum. 3) closed form. 4) compare MC. 5) state approximation validity.
formulas: C = DF tick[(mu - K)N(z) + s phi(z)]

title: Temperature delta of a weather option by bump-and-revalue
deliverables: summary json: base_price, bumped_up, bumped_down, temp_delta
frame: DIKETAHUI: MC setup (seasonal mean, OU, K, tick, r, T, seed), bump h (deg F). DITANYAKAN: dPrice/d(mean temperature shift) per 1 degree. RUMUS: Card 7: shift s(t) by +-h; same random numbers; central difference. JAWAB: 1) fix Z. 2) price at s+h, s-h. 3) (P+ - P-)/(2h). 4) check HDD call delta < 0, CDD call > 0.

title: Vega of a weather option to temperature volatility
frame: DIKETAHUI: MC setup, base sigma, bump (absolute or relative as fraction). DITANYAKAN: dPrice/dsigma and bump reported as fraction. RUMUS: Card 7 / V3: absolute bump d sigma; relative 1% -> 0.01 sigma; same Z. JAWAB: 1) price at sigma +- d. 2) central difference. 3) report bump per V3. 4) check vega > 0 near ATM.
pitfalls: bump reported as 1.0 for a 1% bump

title: Mean-reversion speed sensitivity of a weather option
frame: DIKETAHUI: MC setup with kappa, bump h. DITANYAKAN: dPrice/dkappa. RUMUS: Card 7; same Z, central difference. JAWAB: 1) price at kappa +- h. 2) derivative. 3) interpret: higher kappa shrinks index variance -> lower option value.

title: Weather option price across a strike ladder
frame: DIKETAHUI: index history or MC indices [N], strikes [m], tick, r, T. DITANYAKAN: Call and put prices per strike. RUMUS: Card 3: price(K) = DF tick mean((I - K)^+); put analog. JAWAB: 1) for each K payoffs. 2) prices. 3) check call decreasing convex in K, put increasing.

title: Burn vs Monte Carlo price comparison
deliverables: summary json: burn_price, mc_price, ratio, se
frame: DIKETAHUI: historical index [Y], MC price with SE. DITANYAKAN: Ratio and difference in SE units. RUMUS: Card invariants: within ~20% when calibrated to same history; tick in both legs. JAWAB: 1) both prices in currency. 2) ratio. 3) flag if ratio ~ tick or > 1.2.
pitfalls: tick applied in only one leg (~tick-fold gap)

title: Seller risk quantiles of weather option payoff
frame: DIKETAHUI: simulated (or historical) payoffs [N], level alpha. DITANYAKAN: VaR and ES of the seller's payout. RUMUS: VaR = sorted[ceil(alpha n)-1]; ES = mean of payouts >= VaR. JAWAB: 1) payoffs. 2) quantile per stated method. 3) ES. 4) check ES >= VaR >= mean.

title: Actuarial premium: standard-deviation principle
frame: DIKETAHUI: historical or simulated payoffs, loading lambda, r, T. DITANYAKAN: Premium = DF (E + lambda sd) (or as defined). RUMUS: Jewson-Brix: premium = DF (E[payoff] + lambda sd[payoff]); variance principle E + lambda Var. JAWAB: 1) E, sd (ddof=1). 2) premium. 3) report loading used.

title: Discounting weather option payoffs to valuation date
frame: DIKETAHUI: expected payoff, r, valuation and payment dates, day count. DITANYAKAN: DF and present value. RUMUS: Card 3: DF = e^{-rT}, T = (pay - val)/365 (or stated basis). JAWAB: 1) T. 2) DF. 3) PV. 4) check DF < 1.

title: Multi-city weather option portfolio table
deliverables: per-contract table: city, type, period, strike, index_mean, price
frame: DIKETAHUI: per-station temperature data; contracts [M] (city, HDD/CDD, call/put, period, K, tick). DITANYAKAN: Price per contract and portfolio total. RUMUS: Card 2-4 per contract; base per contract. JAWAB: 1) per station indices per year. 2) per contract payoff. 3) burn price. 4) portfolio sum with positions.

title: Weather hedge ratio from revenue regression
frame: DIKETAHUI: annual revenues [Y], index [Y], tick. DITANYAKAN: Hedge ratio and contracts to short/long. RUMUS: OLS revenue = a + beta I; contracts n = -beta/tick; variance reduction = R^2. JAWAB: 1) OLS. 2) n. 3) hedged revenue variance. 4) check reduction = R^2.

title: Basis risk: correlation between station indices
frame: DIKETAHUI: index per year at two stations. DITANYAKAN: Pearson correlation and cross-hedge effectiveness. RUMUS: rho = corr(I_A, I_B); effectiveness rho^2; min-variance ratio rho sd_A/sd_B. JAWAB: 1) align years. 2) correlation. 3) ratio. 4) report.

title: Index from hourly temperatures variant
frame: DIKETAHUI: hourly temperatures, base. DITANYAKAN: Daily average as mean of hourly readings (V2b) and resulting index vs (Tmax+Tmin)/2. RUMUS: Card V2. JAWAB: 1) group hourly by date. 2) mean, and max/min avg. 3) degree days both ways. 4) report the named convention.

title: CAT index (cumulative average temperature)
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily temps (C), period, K, tick. DITANYAKAN: CAT index = sum of daily average temperatures over the period; option/futures value. RUMUS: CME CAT: I = sum_d T_d (no base); payoff tick (I - K)^+. JAWAB: 1) T_d. 2) sum over period. 3) payoff, burn price. 4) check index sign can be negative in winter for C.

title: Pacific Rim average temperature index
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily temps, period, K, tick. DITANYAKAN: PRIM = average of daily average temperature over the period. RUMUS: Average (not sum) over days for this index type; payoff with tick. JAWAB: 1) T_d. 2) average. 3) payoffs, price.
pitfalls: summing when the index is an average

title: Weekly HDD contract index
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily temps, week definition (days included). DITANYAKAN: Weekly index values. RUMUS: Sum of daily HDD over the contract's days of the week as specified. JAWAB: 1) define week windows. 2) sum. 3) check day count per week.

title: Seasonal strip vs sum of monthly indices
deliverables: table: year, monthly indices, season total, diff
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily temps, season months. DITANYAKAN: Strip index and check equals sum of monthly. RUMUS: Additivity of sums. JAWAB: 1) monthly per year. 2) seasonal direct. 3) difference ~0. 4) season spans year end: assign to season year.

title: Binary (digital) HDD option
frame: DIKETAHUI: index history or MC [N], K, payout amount, r, T. DITANYAKAN: Probability I > K and price DF payout P. RUMUS: price = DF payout mean(1{I > K}); MC SE = DF payout sqrt(p(1-p)/N). JAWAB: 1) indicator. 2) frequency. 3) price. 4) SE.

title: Index trend estimate and forecast for next season
deliverables: summary json: slope, intercept, forecast, prediction_sd
frame: DIKETAHUI: index per year [Y], target year. DITANYAKAN: Trend slope (points/year), forecast and prediction interval. RUMUS: OLS; forecast a + c y*; prediction se = s sqrt(1 + 1/Y + (y* - ybar)^2/Sxx). JAWAB: 1) OLS. 2) forecast. 3) interval. 4) report.

title: Bootstrap confidence interval of burn price
deliverables: summary json: burn_price, boot_se, ci_low, ci_high
frame: DIKETAHUI: payoffs per year [Y], n_boot, seed, level. DITANYAKAN: Bootstrap SE and percentile CI of burn price. RUMUS: Resample years with replacement; DF mean per resample. JAWAB: 1) payoffs. 2) n_boot resamples. 3) sd and percentiles. 4) check CI contains point estimate.

title: Burn price sensitivity to look-back length
frame: DIKETAHUI: index per year [Y], look-back lengths [m], K, tick, r, T. DITANYAKAN: Burn price using last L years for each L. RUMUS: Card 4 on subsamples. JAWAB: 1) sort years. 2) take last L. 3) price. 4) report and comment on trend effect.
formulas: P_L = DF tick mean_{last L years} (I - K)^+

title: Dornier-Queruel drift with seasonal mean derivative
frame: DIKETAHUI: s(t) coefficients, kappa, sigma, T0, horizon. DITANYAKAN: Simulated temperatures whose mean follows s(t). RUMUS: Card 5: dT = [s'(t) + kappa(s(t) - T)]dt + sigma dW; s'(t) = b + c w cos(w t + phi); simulating the residual Y = T - s exactly is equivalent. JAWAB: 1) residual OU exact. 2) T = s + Y. 3) check mean path -> s(t) not lagged.
formulas: s'(t) = b + c (2pi/365) cos(2 pi t/365 + phi)
pitfalls: omitting ds/dt makes the mean lag s(t)

title: Euler simulation of temperature OU
frame: DIKETAHUI: seasonal fit, kappa, sigma per day, K, tick, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: Price with Euler daily steps vs exact. RUMUS: Euler: Y' = Y(1 - kappa) + sigma Z; exact: Y e^{-kappa} + sigma sqrt((1-e^{-2kappa})/(2kappa)) Z. JAWAB: 1) same Z. 2) both prices. 3) difference. 4) report the scheme named.

title: Sanity checks on degree-day outputs
frame: DIKETAHUI: computed daily and period indices. DITANYAKAN: Pass/fail of invariants. RUMUS: Card invariants: HDD >= 0; monthly >> daily; winter HDD > summer HDD; HDD_d CDD_d = 0; index = sum. JAWAB: 1) run checks. 2) report any failures with cause.
formulas: I_month ~ n_days x mean daily HDD

title: Antithetic variance reduction in weather MC
deliverables: summary json: price_plain, se_plain, price_anti, se_anti
frame: DIKETAHUI: MC setup, n_paths, seed. DITANYAKAN: Price and SE with and without antithetic paths. RUMUS: Use Z and -Z; SE from pair averages. JAWAB: 1) plain MC. 2) antithetic. 3) compare SE.
pitfalls: SE computed on all 2N values as independent

title: Weather option burn-analysis put-call parity
frame: DIKETAHUI: index history [Y], K, tick, r, T. DITANYAKAN: C - P - DF tick (mean I - K) residual. RUMUS: (I-K)^+ - (K-I)^+ = I - K holds per year. JAWAB: 1) call, put burn. 2) residual. 3) check ~0.

title: Capped call as a call spread
frame: DIKETAHUI: K, cap in currency, tick, index sample. DITANYAKAN: Price of capped call and of call(K) - call(K + cap/tick). RUMUS: min(tick (I-K)^+, cap) = tick[(I-K)^+ - (I-K-cap/tick)^+]. JAWAB: 1) upper strike. 2) both prices. 3) diff ~0.

title: Implied market price of risk from a quoted weather option
frame: DIKETAHUI: OU fit, quoted price, contract terms. DITANYAKAN: lambda solving model price = market price. RUMUS: Alaton: risk-neutral drift adds -lambda sigma to the residual; price(lambda) by MC (fixed Z) or normal approx; brentq. JAWAB: 1) price function. 2) bracket. 3) solve. 4) check monotone in lambda.
formulas: dY = (-kappa Y - lambda sigma)dt + sigma dW

title: Residual diagnostics after seasonal and AR(1) fit
deliverables: summary json: acf_lag1, lb_stat, lb_pvalue, skew, kurt
frame: DIKETAHUI: innovations eps [n]. DITANYAKAN: ACF, Ljung-Box, skew/kurtosis by month. RUMUS: Q = n(n+2) sum_k rho_k^2/(n-k), chi2(m). JAWAB: 1) ACF. 2) LB. 3) moments. 4) note remaining structure.

title: Strike at a target exceedance probability
frame: DIKETAHUI: index sample (historical or MC), target p. DITANYAKAN: K with P(I > K) = p. RUMUS: K = quantile(I, 1 - p) (state method). JAWAB: 1) quantile. 2) empirical check. 3) report.

title: Temperature model calibration report (full pipeline)
deliverables: summary json: a, b, c, phi, kappa, sigma, half_life_days
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily Tmax, Tmin [n_days]. DITANYAKAN: All seasonal and OU parameters with units. RUMUS: Card 1, 5; toolkit ar1_fit(add_const=False), ou_from_ar1. JAWAB: 1) T_d. 2) seasonal OLS. 3) residuals. 4) AR(1). 5) OU map, half-life. 6) units stated (per day default).

title: HDD option on a single year realised settlement
frame: DIKETAHUI: daily temps for the contract period, K, tick, cap. DITANYAKAN: Realised index and settlement payoff (currency). RUMUS: Card 2-3. JAWAB: 1) index. 2) payoff with cap. 3) report.
